subject.title: feat(subagents): native announceTarget for subagent completion routing (#27445)

question: Should OpenClaw accept `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"` as a public native `sessions_spawn` and `agents.*.subagents` contract after the resolver bug and proof gap are fixed?
rationale: The implementation adds durable model-facing and config semantics in message-delivery/session-state code, which repository policy treats as product and compatibility sensitive even though the high-level shape is plausible.

options.title: Accept opt-in parent routing
options.body: Land this PR or an equivalent after normalized per-agent lookup is fixed, current channel delivery remains the default, upgrade behavior is proven, and real behavior proof is posted.

options.title: Per-spawn only first
options.body: Keep the model-facing per-call option but defer global/per-agent defaults until operator and upgrade semantics are reviewed separately.

options.title: Keep callback workaround
options.body: Pause or close this direction and leave parent handoff to explicit `sessions_send` patterns until a broader orchestration contract is chosen.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in parent routing
recommendation.body: Land this PR or an equivalent after normalized per-agent lookup is fixed, current channel delivery remains the default, upgrade behavior is proven, and real behavior proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the tool area and already provided the focused implementation shape on the linked issue.
